description: This file is a FastAPI backend server implementing REST APIs for a PDF logo replacement service. It defines endpoints for starting a job, checking status, generating previews, confirming results, and downloading PDFs or ZIP archives of results. It leverages external modules for core processing, storage, and zip creation.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: A health endpoint that returns a simple message indicating the service is running.

methods.name: start_logo_replace_job( pdf: UploadFile = File(..., description="The input PDF file"), old_logos: list[UploadFile] = File(..., description="One or more images of the old logo to detect"), new_logo: UploadFile = File(..., description="The new logo image to overlay in place of detected old logos"), dpi: int = Form(250, description="Rasterization DPI for detection (200-300 recommended)"), max_pages: Optional[int] = Form(None, description="Optional cap on number of pages to process"), match_threshold: float = Form(0.8, description="Template matching threshold (0.0-1.0)"), )
methods.description: Endpoint to initiate a logo replacement job by uploading the PDF, old logos, and new logo with optional parameters.

methods.name: get_status(job_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieve the processing status and results for a specific job ID.

methods.name: get_preview(job_id: str, page_index: int, type: str = "detected")
methods.description: Return a PNG preview image for a specific page of a job, showing either detected logos or overlays.

methods.name: confirm_job(job_id: str)
methods.description: Stub endpoint to confirm and mark a job as completed.

methods.name: download_replaced_pdf(job_id: str)
methods.description: Download the final PDF result for a completed job.

methods.name: download_replaced_zip(job_id: str)
methods.description: Download a ZIP archive containing all outputs related to the job.

ctags.name: get_preview
ctags.pattern: /^def get_preview(job_id: str, page_index: int, type: str = "detected"):$/

ctags.name: start_logo_replace_job
ctags.signature: ( pdf: UploadFile = File(..., description="The input PDF file"), old_logos: list[UploadFile] = File(..., description="One or more images of the old logo to detect"), new_logo: UploadFile = File(..., description="The new logo image to overlay in place of detected old logos"), dpi: int = Form(250, description="Rasterization DPI for detection (200-300 recommended)"), max_pages: Optional[int] = Form(None, description="Optional cap on number of pages to process"), match_threshold: float = Form(0.8, description="Template matching threshold (0.0-1.0)"), )
